view.title: View session recordings
view.description: See and play back your own session recordings.

audit.title: Audit every session
audit.description: See and play back everyone's recordings, see who opened each one, put recordings on hold and watch or end live sessions.

rules.title: Manage command alert rules
rules.description: Add and change the rules that alert on, or end, a session when a command matches.

retentionDays.label: Retention (days)
retentionDays.description: How long a session recording is kept before it is deleted automatically.

forceRecording.label: Require recording
forceRecording.description: Record every session even when a host has recording turned off. Users can't stop a required recording.

encryptRecordings.label: Encrypt recordings
encryptRecordings.description: Encrypt new recordings on disk. Recordings made before stay as they are.

alertOnAccess.label: Alert when a recording is opened
alertOnAccess.description: Send an alert to auditors when someone watches, downloads or live watches a session.
alertOnAccess.others: When it is someone else's session

enable.label: Enable session recording
enable.description: Record terminal output for this host so you can play it back or download it later.

includeOutputTimestamps.label: Timestamps in text downloads
includeOutputTimestamps.description: Download as text puts the time each line was printed at its start, in UTC. Recordings and playback stay the same.

alwaysShowActions.label: Always show buttons
alwaysShowActions.description: Keep the view, download and delete buttons under each log visible. Turn off to show them only on hover.

sessionLogs.title: Session Logs
sessionLogs.noLogsDesc: Enable session logging on a host to start recording
sessionLogs.verifyChanged: The recording was changed after it was saved
sessionLogs.verifyUnknown: This recording has no saved fingerprint to compare with
sessionLogs.holdOn: Recording put on hold. It won't be deleted.
sessionLogs.missingTimestamps: This recording has no timing, so it can't be downloaded with timestamps.

plugin.name: Session Recording
plugin.description: Record terminal and remote desktop sessions, watch them live, and keep an audited, encrypted record of who did what.

live.noneHint: Open SSH and remote desktop sessions of every user show here.
live.displayUnavailable: Remote Desktop is needed to watch this session

rules.intro: Alert or end a session when someone types or sees a line that matches.
rules.name: Name
rules.patternHint: Text to look for in one line. Case does not matter.
rules.regexHint: Treat the match as a regular expression.
